tasks.dev: deno run -A npm:concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "deno task --cwd apps/server dev" "deno task --cwd apps/web dev"
tasks.build: deno task --cwd apps/server build && deno task --cwd apps/web build
tasks.check: deno task --cwd packages/common check && deno task --cwd apps/server check && deno task --cwd apps/web check
